note: Offline reference material for the landing-page route. The generating agent has no network access, so comparison and social-proof sections draw on these neutral archetypes rather than naming real companies. Replace a row's text with something specific to the product idea; never present these as researched facts about named competitors.

archetypes.name: A spreadsheet
archetypes.strength: Free, flexible, and already open on most desks.
archetypes.weakness: Breaks quietly once more than one person edits it, and nothing validates what gets typed in.

archetypes.name: Pen and paper
archetypes.strength: Nothing to learn and never offline.
archetypes.weakness: Cannot be searched, counted, or recovered once mislaid.

archetypes.name: A group chat
archetypes.weakness: Decisions scroll away, and there is no list of the current state of anything.

archetypes.name: A full enterprise suite
archetypes.strength: Handles every case an organisation could have.
archetypes.weakness: Priced and configured for teams far larger than one, with a setup cost measured in weeks.

archetypes.name: A notes app
archetypes.strength: Quick to capture anything at all.
archetypes.weakness: Every entry is free text, so nothing can be filtered, totalled, or checked for gaps.

proofPatterns: Set up in a couple of minutes, with nothing to install.
Works entirely on this device — no account, no sign-up.
Every entry stays where you put it, including after a refresh.

faq.question: Where is my data kept?
faq.answer: In this browser, on this device. Nothing is uploaded.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: No. There is no sign-up and no password.

faq.question: Can I use it on my phone?
faq.answer: Yes. The layout adapts to narrow screens.
